items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components.

Check alignment and compare it with the setting 
 value.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it.

Check the validity of grease and add or change 
 it.
Check glands for leaking and re-packing.
Check flanges for leaking and re-tight.

Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint.

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
This pump is used for 
 drawing the leakage air from the circuit of cooling water.
Technical specification
Type of pump | 50 SZO 224 45 Sigma Zavadka
Design : | Horizontal with a Separator
Drawn in medium | Air water vapors
Drawn in air volume | 41 m3 / h at absolute. Pressure 10 
 kPa
Pump Speed | 1450 RPM
Input of air pump | 2.15 KW
Type of motor | 4 AP 112 M
Motor output | 4.4 Kw Motor 
 Speed 1450 rpm.
Voltage | 380 V / 50 HZ
Quantity of make-up water | 0.48 m3 / h, Pressure 
 150 kPa, absolute
Weight | 40 kg
Bearing Type: | 6303 - 3303
Material: | Bronze impeller, body cast 
 iron, separator carbon steel

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components.
Pump out of Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting 
 value.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it.
Check the validity of grease and add or change 
 it.
Check glands for leaking and re-packing.
Check flanges for leaking and re-tight.
Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint.
